[SWS_CM_90480] Argument serializedData in E2E_check for method requests
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00400, RS_E2E_08541
⌈
For the given E2E-protected
Method
request,
E2E_check()
shall be invoked on the
protected serialized data (passed as argument
serializedData
to
E2E_check()
)
according to [RS_E2E_08541], [PRS_E2E_00323], and [PRS_E2E_00828].
⌋
